Drew impulsively gives away his dog Speedy as a big-hearted gesture to impress a woman, then regrets it. The episode marks Drew Carey's directorial debut.

Frustrated when her colleagues fawn over a newly pregnant co-worker, Audrey pretends she is pregnant in hopes of getting special treatment too.
